name: Emollients (Doublebase/Diprobase/Cetraben)
dosing: Apply liberally and frequently (minimum QDS and after washing)
interactions: None - can reduce topical steroid absorption if applied simultaneously
monitoring: Skin hydration, infection risk in damaged skin
sideEffects: Folliculitis, contact reaction (fragranced products), fire hazard with paraffin-based
pharmacokinetics: Local skin hydration, no systemic absorption
clinicalPearls: Foundation of eczema management. Apply separate from steroids (20-30min gap). FIRE HAZARD - paraffin-based emollients on fabric. Use soap substitutes
indication: Eczema, dry skin conditions, psoriasis (adjunct), ichthyosis
